title: BUDGET AND FINANCE COMMITTEE REPORT relative to a data-sharing reciprocal agreement with the State Franchise Tax Board (FTB) for the exchange of tax data…
text:
[Council File 26-1417]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
BUDGET AND FINANCE COMMITTEE REPORT relative to a data-sharing reciprocal agreement with the State Franchise Tax Board (FTB) for the exchange of tax data specific to City business license information for tax administration purposes.
Recommendation(s) for Council action:
1. AUTHORIZE the Director, Office of Finance, to execute a three-year data-sharing reciprocal agreement between the City of Los Angeles (City) and the FTB, for the period of January 1, 2027 through December 31, 2029.
2. NOTE and FILE the Office of Finance report dated September 14, 2026, attached to the Council file.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
None submitted by the Office of Finance. Neither the City Administrative Officer nor the Chief Legislative Analyst has completed a financial analysis of this report.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
